    <tr>

                        <!-- header image -->
            
            
            
            <tr>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html dir="ltr">
<head>
  
  
  
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta http-equiv="x-ua-compatible" content="ie=edge">
  <title></title>
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <meta name="color-scheme" content="light dark only">
  <meta name="supported-color-schemes" content="light dark only">
  
  <style type="text/css">
    .go-growth-desktop-only {
      display: table !important;
    }
    .go-growth-mobile-only {
      display: none !important;
      width: 0 !important;
      max-height: 0 !important;
      overflow: hidden !important;
      mso-hide: all !important;
    }
    @media screen and (max-width:480px) {
      .go-growth-desktop-only {
        display: none !important;
        font-size: 0 !important;
        line-height: 0 !important;
        max-height: 0 !important;
        overflow: hidden !important;
        mso-hide: all !important;
      }
      .go-growth-mobile-only {
        display: table !important;
        width: 100% !important;
        max-height: none !important;
        height: auto !important;
        overflow: visible !important;
        mso-hide: none !important;
      }
      .go-growth-mobile-only tr,
      .go-growth-mobile-only td {
        max-height: none !important;
      }
    }
  </style>

  <style type="text/css">
  /**
   * Google webfonts. Recommended to include the .woff version for cross-client compatibility.
   */
  @media screen {
    /* OpenAI Sans font family */
    @font-face {
      font-display: swap;
      font-family: "OpenAI Sans";
      font-style: normal;
      font-weight: 400;
      src: url("https://cdn.openai.com/common/fonts/openai-sans/v2/OpenAISans-Regular.woff2") format("woff2");
    }

    @font-face {
      font-display: swap;
      font-family: "OpenAI Sans";
      font-style: normal;
      font-weight: 500;
      src: url("https://cdn.openai.com/common/fonts/openai-sans/v2/OpenAISans-Medium.woff2") format("woff2");
    }

    @font-face {
      font-display: swap;
      font-family: "OpenAI Sans";
      font-style: normal;
      font-weight: 600;
      src: url("https://cdn.openai.com/common/fonts/openai-sans/v2/OpenAISans-Semibold.woff2") format("woff2");
    }

    @font-face {
      font-display: swap;
      font-family: "OpenAI Sans";
      font-style: normal;
      font-weight: 700;
      src: url("https://cdn.openai.com/common/fonts/openai-sans/v2/OpenAISans-Bold.woff2") format("woff2");
    }
  }

  :root {
    color-scheme: light dark only;
    supported-color-schemes: light dark only;
  }

  /**
   * Avoid browser level font resizing.
   * 1. Windows Mobile
   * 2. iOS / OSX
   */
  body,
  table,
  td,
  a {
    -ms-text-size-adjust: 100%; /* 1 */
    -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; /* 2 */
    font-family: 'OpenAI Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
  }

  /**
   * Remove extra space added to tables and cells in Outlook.
   */
  table,
  td {
    mso-table-rspace: 0pt;
    mso-table-lspace: 0pt;
    vertical-align: top; /* Align content to the top of table cells */
  }

  /**
   * Better fluid images in Internet Explorer.
   */
  img {

  /**
   * Remove blue links for iOS devices.
   */
  a[x-apple-data-detectors] {

    font-size: inherit !important;
    font-weight: inherit !important;
    line-height: inherit !important;

   */
  div[style*="margin: 16px 0;"] {

  }

  a.button-invert:hover span,

  }

Say the word, build your sound

The chat bar turns your words into new sounds, plugins made

control of every instrument and voice.

messages.subject: Terms of service changes to your Suno account
messages.body:
We're writing to notify you of changes to Suno's Terms of Service
(https://clicks.suno.com/f/a/ygGguI8fmq1g68cZ4fZY8Q~~/AAQRxRA~/is4UWTDBJoGJw7b3ITKFYAny3EMxNAuzk3mzP4-U_ljdxqYK6I_W3QCDRBqQGnCEdf4T0Nvn5A4gLmeE8rgs54rs6Twor7P18tRC24wJ_qtoIC0M2v65-frNXG_uJd0OvFKsbRFg6bw7zwUs1n7J2A~~) that will affect your Suno
account, effective September 3, 2026.

What is changing:

* Downloads: Your free account will include 3 trial downloads. This
  means you can save up to 3 songs to your device. Listening and sharing
  your full library on Suno stay unlimited.

* Your content and commercial use: We've clarified the rights you have
  in your content and how commercial use of music generated with Suno
  works. Trial downloads cannot be used for commercial use.

* Resolving disputes: We've updated how disputes between you and Suno
  are handled, including updates to our Arbitration Agreement and
  provisions governing mass arbitrations.

Learn More (https://clicks.suno.com/f/a/LiiMyxQBJI-37TPp4xuesg~~/AAQRxRA~/OUdgmjczF-93pelE3NkTdSrJ88eo9EST7w8WVDaL16XYbQJG9lAtmtYh2tv8scBLdW9qtHRgUnfxyqevCKXc4oaaal96et6CEiWa_ZjStCAIBYCxQoTtnEfS1tw2pfDn0LcqER3aaV-H8rtaVA3rlw~~)

Why we are making these changes: As our platform grows, limiting
downloads will make it harder for bad actors to mass-export music. We
are introducing download limits to ensure our platform is used for
intentional music creation, while still allowing everyone to create,
remix, listen, and share on Suno. Read more
(https://clicks.suno.com/f/a/LiiMyxQBJI-37TPp4xuesg~~/AAQRxRA~/OUdgmjczF-93pelE3NkTdSrJ88eo9EST7w8WVDaL16XYbQJG9lAtmtYh2tv8scBLdW9qtHRgUnfxyqevCKXc4oaaal96et6CEiWa_ZjStCAIBYCxQoTtnEfS1tw2pfDn0LcqER3aaV-H8rtaVA3rlw~~) about the changes and what's
ahead.

Acceptance: By continuing to use Suno after September 3, 2026, you
accept the updated Terms of Service.

Questions? Our FAQ is here (https://clicks.suno.com/f/a/P5c2HBH_jU3M65RHMXrGRA~~/AAQRxRA~/s4Z2vPiH0F49S-OWp9HFdGJyUJX9I8_UXSYQ9-te8MyTMTJnnEeutjN0_UNNgN5i_GDfvnxPw7JaLD9MGxV-50uuo_-O_N_9rmjMmOrb_YeRW37KfBcfwO9FtQlsvokHi5fUJVbFOPWmTZoDgsQ3og~~).

------------------------------------------------------------
Suno 101 Main Street Cambridge, Massachusetts 02142

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html dir="ltr">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta http-equiv="x-ua-compatible" content="ie=edge">
  <title></title>
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <!-- Hint clients that we explicitly support light/dark rendering. -->
  <meta name="color-scheme" content="light dark only">
  <meta name="supported-color-schemes" content="light dark only">
  
  <style type="text/css">
    @media screen and (max-width:480px) {
      .text-only-email-title-with-break {
        font-size:30px !important;
        line-height:36px !important;
      }
    }
  </style>

  <style type="text/css">
  /**
   * Google webfonts. Recommended to include the .woff version for cross-client compatibility.
   */
  @media screen {
    /* OpenAI Sans font family */
    @font-face {
      font-display: swap;
      font-family: "OpenAI Sans";
      font-style: normal;
      font-weight: 400;
      src: url("https://cdn.openai.com/common/fonts/openai-sans/v2/OpenAISans-Regular.woff2") format("woff2");
    }

    @font-face {
      font-display: swap;
      font-family: "OpenAI Sans";
      font-style: normal;
      font-weight: 500;
      src: url("https://cdn.openai.com/common/fonts/openai-sans/v2/OpenAISans-Medium.woff2") format("woff2");
    }

    @font-face {
      font-display: swap;
      font-family: "OpenAI Sans";
      font-style: normal;
      font-weight: 600;
      src: url("https://cdn.openai.com/common/fonts/openai-sans/v2/OpenAISans-Semibold.woff2") format("woff2");
    }

    @font-face {
      font-display: swap;
      font-family: "OpenAI Sans";
      font-style: normal;
      font-weight: 700;
      src: url("https://cdn.openai.com/common/fonts/openai-sans/v2/OpenAISans-Bold.woff2") format("woff2");
    }
  }

  :root {
    color-scheme: light dark only;
    supported-color-schemes: light dark only;
  }

  /**
   * Avoid browser level font resizing.
   * 1. Windows Mobile
   * 2. iOS / OSX
   */
  body,
  table,
  td,
  a {
    -ms-text-size-adjust: 100%; /* 1 */
    -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; /* 2 */
    font-family: 'OpenAI Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
  }

  /**
   * Remove extra space added to tables and cells in Outlook.
   */
  table,
  td {
    mso-table-rspace: 0pt;
    mso-table-lspace: 0pt;
    vertical-align: top; /* Align content to the top of table cells */
  }

  /**
   * Better fluid images in Internet Explorer.
   */
  img {
    -ms-interpolation-mode: bicubic;
  }

  /**
   * Remove blue links for iOS devices.
   */
  a[x-apple-data-detectors] {
    font-family: inherit !important;
    font-size: inherit !important;
    font-weight: inherit !important;
    line-height: inherit !important;
    color: inherit !important;
    text-decoration: none !important;
  }

  /**
   * Fix centering issues in Android 4.4.
   */
  div[style*="margin: 16px 0;"] {
    margin: 0 !important;
  }

  body {
    width: 100% !important;
    height: 100% !important;
    padding: 0 !important;
    margin: 0 !important;
  }

  /**
   * Collapse table borders to avoid space between cells.
   */
  table {
    border-collapse: collapse !important;
  }

  a {
    color: #898A8D;
  }

  .image-reset-bullets,
  .image-reset-bullets .email-bullet-link {
      color: #000000;
  }

  /* Give the ChatGPT logo pill consistent breathing room in light mode. */
  .email-logo-pill {
      background-color: #ffffff;
      border-radius: 12px;
      padding: 13px;
      display: inline-block;
  }

  img {
    height: auto;
    line-height: 100%;
    text-decoration: none;
    border: 0;
    outline: none;
  }

  /* Composer image sizing (mobile default) */
  .composer-img {
      width: 83px !important;
      height: auto !important;
      padding: 16px !important;
  }

  h1 {
      font-size: 34px;
      line-height: 41px;
      font-weight: 400;
      letter-spacing: 0.4px;
      margin: 0;
  }
  h2 {
      font-size: 18px;
      font-weight: 400;
      margin: 0;
      line-height: 150%;
      letter-spacing: -0.2px;
  }
  p {
      font-size: 16px;
      line-height: 130%;
      font-weight: 500;
      margin: 0;
  }
  p + p {
      margin-top: 16px;
  }
  /* Intro blocks (H1/H2) sizing */
  .intro-block {
      width: 345px !important;
      max-width: 345px !important;
  }
  /* Composer card sizing */
  .composer-card {
      width: 377px !important;
      max-width: 377px !important;
  }
  /* Button styling */
  a.button {
      background-color: #000000 !important; /* default black */
      border-radius: 24px !important; /* make button curvy */
      padding: 11.5px 24px 11.5px !important; /* bigger size */
      font-size: 16px !important; /* revert text size */
      line-height: 24px !important;
  }

  a.button:active {
      background-color: #414141 !important; /* dark gray on click */
      border-radius: 36px !important;
  }
  /* CTA button hover state (supported clients only) */
  a.button-invert:hover,
  a.button-invert:focus {
      background-color: #000000 !important;
      background-image: none !important;
      color: #FFFFFF !important;
      border-color: #FFFFFF !important;
  }
  a.button-invert:hover span,
  a.button-invert:focus span {
      color: #FFFFFF !important;
  }
  @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
      a.button-invert {
          background-color: #FFFFFF !important;
          background-image: linear-gradient(#FFFFFF, #FFFFFF) !important;
          color: #000000 !important;
          border-color: #FFFFFF !important;
          -webkit-text-fill-color: #000000 !important;
      }
      a.button-invert span {
          color: #000000 !important;
          -webkit-text-fill-color: #000000 !important;
      }
  }
  [data-ogsc] a.button-invert,
  [data-ogsb] a.button-invert {
      background-color: #FFFFFF !important;
      background-image: linear-gradient(#FFFFFF, #FFFFFF) !important;
      color: #000000 !important;
      border-color: #FFFFFF !important;
      -webkit-text-fill-color: #000000 !important;
  }
  [data-ogsc] a.button-invert span,
  [data-ogsb] a.button-invert span {
      color: #000000 !important;
      -webkit-text-fill-color: #000000 !important;
  }
  /* Ensure hover keeps text legible even with dark-mode overrides. */
  a.button-invert:hover,
  a.button-invert:focus {
      color: #FFFFFF !important;
      -webkit-text-fill-color: #FFFFFF !important;
  }
  a.button-invert:hover span,
  a.button-invert:focus span {
      color: #FFFFFF !important;
      -webkit-text-fill-color: #FFFFFF !important;
  }
  /* Badges: use real rows so the stacked layout survives across email clients */
  .badges {
      width: 100% !important;
      max-width: 128px !important;
  }
  .badges .badge {
      width: 100% !important;
      vertical-align: bottom !important;
  }
  .badges .badge img {
      width: 120px !important;
      max-width: 120px !important;
      height: auto !important;
      margin: 0 auto !important;
  }

  /* Desktop: larger typography */
  @media screen and (min-width:480px) {
      h1 {
          font-size: 34px !important;
          line-height: 41px !important;
          letter-spacing: 0.4px;
          font-weight: 400 !important;
      }
      h2 {
        font-size: 18px;
        font-weight: 400;
        margin: 0;
        line-height: 150%;
        letter-spacing: -0.2px;
      }
      /* Header cell: increase side padding on desktop only */
      td.header-td {
          padding-left: 57px !important;
          padding-right: 57px !important;
      }
      /* Composer image sizing for desktop */
      .composer-img {
          width: 98px !important;
      }
      /* Body content cells: increase side padding on desktop */
      td.content-td {
          padding-left: 60px !important;
          padding-right: 60px !important;
      }
      td.footer-td {
          padding-left: 56px !important;
          padding-right: 56px !important;
      }
      p {
          font-size: 16px !important;
          line-height: 130% !important;
          font-weight: 400;
      }
      td {
          font-size: 10px !important;
          line-height: 16px !important;
          font-weight: 400;
      }
      a.button {
          font-size: 16px !important;
          line-height: 24px !important;
      }
      .footer-row td {
          vertical-align: bottom !important;
          padding-left: 0 !important;
      }
      /* Composer card width on desktop */
      .composer-card {
          width: 400px !important;
          max-width: 400px !important;
      }
      /* Intro blocks width on desktop */
      .intro-block {
          width: 360px !important;
          max-width: 360px !important;

messages.subject: New privacy settings for Search services
messages.snippet: bennysairamjogi@gmail.com Hello BENNY SAI RAM, We're updating our settings to give you even more control over saved history and personalized recommendations across Google Search services, including
messages.body:
Google Logo
 

bennysairamjogi@gmail.com
 

Hello BENNY SAI RAM,

We’re updating our settings to give you even more control over saved  
history and personalized recommendations across Google Search services,  
including Search, Maps, Shopping, Hotels, Flights, Translate, and News.  
You’ll see this change in your Google Account in the next few days.

What’s changing

Previously, saving history and personalization were managed by Web & App  
Activity. Going forward, we're introducing two new settings to help you  
better tailor your experience: Search Services History and Personalized  
Recommendations. These settings let you revisit your past searches and  
decide if you want your experience to be personalized. You can turn these  
settings on or off at any time. As people increasingly search in new ways,  
like searching a photo with Lens, Search Services History now includes  
media from your interactions, which you can stop saving at any time.

How this affects your account

New history and personalization settings: These new settings will reflect  
your most recent choices for Web & App Activity and Search Personalization  
settings. If these are currently on, these new settings will stay on. If  
they’re off, the new settings will be off. After the transition, Web & App  
Activity and Search services settings will be separate, and changes to one  
won’t affect the other.

Auto-delete: Your prior choice from Web & App Activity for how long your  
history is saved will also apply to Search Services History. As always, you  
can change how long history is saved, choose an auto-delete period, and  
review or delete history manually at any time.

Your media is saved when Search Services History is on: Saved media  
includes your images, files, audio and video from your interactions with  
Search services to help improve your experience. For example, this lets you  
revisit your past visual searches with Lens or continue a Search Live  
conversation about a song you heard. To support these types of interactive  
product experiences, Google will now save your media to your Search  
Services History, applying robust privacy and security protections. Like  
your Search Services History, your saved media is also used to develop and  
improve Google services and technologies, including AI models and safety  
measures. With this transition, if your Web & App Activity setting is  
currently turned on, this new Save Media subsetting will also be turned on  
along with your Search Services History. You can turn off your  
<https://c.gle/AOPyDKS4_AZrzu_KDT_1ouAnk6fdrNY_cGy6SX4ei9E-eTx8_WCazuXD1tyL-tl7z4j67AQ6Kc_B3eTooiVUPIMeNtcwpU1IwhTDX3k3lslJEe-_EnJ_nLG8g3DbzLCkki7hn2I7P-rIh-ymHBHt3UerFuZgKwA0ADq8tZOXyX9ksAOTWYdy9Dzhm54B3lETfon1dBwK2jUUBzddoyM0_iQGUHylR-_pfH6aIuRHv3qrqwEgqX_N8A59EvRhuwf6tpkDPtFs9S_arUeD5ciUIPxxLYZLB_IKvm-IisLOnt1FuIMBs1rAGjVQmm2G_qwbmagUaWY1flezeS0w3pxES1lp3HPHoplQq5sZtNP_JAlihcvK-cP_6GLAyG8JL07P-Q>Save

Learn the basics and start creating today Welcome to Suno

Welcome to Suno — where your ideas become music!

Let's get started with the basics:

Credits: As a Basic (free) user, you get 50 credits every day —
enough to make around 10 songs daily.

Generations: Each generation is a song you create with Suno.
You'll see your credits decrease as you create, but they refresh
daily.

Prompts: Your words guide Suno. Being specific helps the system
know exactly what you want.

Lyrics: You can write your own or use Suno to help you.

—

Your turn. Try this prompt today:

"A [mood] [genre] track with [instrument(s)] and a
[tempo/texture]."

See what you can make, then tweak one element — maybe add a
synth or change the tempo — and create again.

We can't wait for you to create a song you love.

messages.subject: Important Update to GitHub Copilot Interaction Data Usage Policy
messages.snippet: ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ GitHub GitHub Hi there, We're updating how GitHub uses data to improve AI-powered coding tools. From April 24 onward, your interactions with GitHub Copilot—
messages.body:
‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌

( https://github.com?utm_source=github&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=FY26MAR-WW-LCM-X-CBCE-AA-Devs-TX-701Kg000000PijXIAS )

Hi there,

We’re updating how GitHub uses data to improve AI-powered coding tools. From April 24 onward, your interactions with GitHub Copilot—including inputs, outputs, code snippets, and associated context—may be used to train and enhance AI models *unless you opt out*.

If you previously opted out of the setting allowing GitHub to collect this data for product improvements, your preference has been retained— your choice is preserved, and your data will not be used for training unless you opt in.

This approach aligns with established industry practices and will enable our models to deliver more context-aware AI coding assistance. We have tested this with Microsoft interaction data and have seen meaningful improvements, including increased acceptance rates in multiple languages.

Please review your settings and choose whether your interactions with Copilot can be leveraged for training AI models before this update goes into effect on April 24. To opt out or adjust your settings:

* Go to *GitHub Account Settings*
* Select *Copilot*
* Choose whether to allow your data to be used for AI model training

To learn more, please refer to our blog post ( https://gh.io/AAzfaht?utm_source=github&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=FY26MAR-WW-LCM-X-CBCE-AA-Devs-TX-701Kg000000PijXIAS ) and FAQ ( https://github.com/orgs/community/discussions/188488?utm_source=github&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=FY26MAR-WW-LCM-X-CBCE-AA-Devs-TX-701Kg000000PijXIAS ).

Please reach out to our support team ( https://docs.github.com/en/support/contacting-github-support?utm_source=github&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=FY26MAR-WW-LCM-X-CBCE-AA-Devs-TX-701Kg000000PijXIAS ) if you have any questions about this update. Thank you for your continued use of GitHub Copilot.

Sincerely,
The GitHub Team

messages.snippet: You now have access to GitHub Copilot. This email outlines what's included in your free plan with GitHub Copilot and how to start using it in your editor and on github.com. Copilot Free includes
messages.body:
You now have access to GitHub Copilot.

This email outlines what’s included in your free plan with GitHub Copilot and how to start using it in your editor and on github.com.
Copilot Free includes access to frontier AI models from OpenAI and Anthropic with monthly usage limits.

Get started with Copilot >: https://github.com/copilot

What's included:

* 50 agent mode requests a month: Use agent mode to debug issues, refactor code, and work through tasks in real time.
* Model choice: Access frontier models from Anthropic and OpenAI.
* Custom instructions: Guide Copilot's responses with your preferred style, conventions, or constraints.
* MCP integrations: Integrate your tools and services using MCP servers. The GitHub MCP Server is available by default.
* Work in your preferred IDE: Available in VS Code, Visual Studio, Xcode, JetBrains, Neovim, Azure Data Studio, Eclipse, and Raycast.
* 2,000 code completions a month: Inline, context-aware code suggestions based on your repository and editor workspace.

Not sure where to start? Try these Copilot Chat prompts >: https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/example-prompts-for-github-copilot-chat

Copilot Settings

Telemetry in your free version of GitHub Copilot is currently enabled. By default, code suggestions that match public code,
including code references in the VS Code and github.com experience, are allowed. You can adjust both telemetry and code suggestion settings in: https://github.com/settings/copilot.
